title: .DS_Store files in Desktop
whyItMatters: Finder writes .DS_Store files into folders you opened; they record folder view settings and reveal which folders were browsed.
source: SWGDE technical notes on macOS artifacts (13-F-002) list .DS_Store as a Finder activity artifact
notes: Narrow replacement for a whole-home walk, which hit maxEntries before finding anything (the walker counts every visited entry). Desktop is TCC-protected without Full Disk Access. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
